title: Jacob Blesses His Twelve Sons

questions.question: What did Jacob gather his sons to tell them?
options: What would happen to them in days to come
Who would be the next leader
questions.correctAnswer: What would happen to them in days to come
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:1 (ESV): "Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in days to come."

questions.question: Who did Jacob call "unstable as water"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:4: "Unstable as water, you shall not have preeminence."

questions.question: Which son did Jacob call a "lion's cub"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:9: "Judah is a lion's cub; from the prey, my son, you have gone up."

questions.question: What animal did Jacob compare Benjamin to?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:27: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, in the morning devouring the prey and at evening dividing the spoil."

questions.question: Where did Jacob ask to be buried?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:29-30: "Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite...the cave of Machpelah."

questions.question: What did Jacob say about Simeon and Levi?
options: Their swords are weapons of violence
questions.correctAnswer: Their swords are weapons of violence
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:5: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their swords."

questions.question: What prophecy was given to Judah regarding the scepter?
options: It shall not depart from him
It will be given to Joseph
He will lose it to Edom
questions.correctAnswer: It shall not depart from him
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:10: "The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet."

questions.question: What did Jacob say about Zebulun?
options: He shall dwell at the shore of the sea
questions.correctAnswer: He shall dwell at the shore of the sea
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:13: "Zebulun shall dwell at the shore of the sea; he shall become a haven for ships."

questions.question: Who is described as a "fruitful bough"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:22: "Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring."

questions.question: What did Jacob say about Dan?
options: He is a doe let loose
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:16: "Dan shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel."

questions.question: Who is described as a 'strong donkey crouching between the sheepfolds'?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:14: "Issachar is a strong donkey, crouching between the sheepfolds."

questions.question: What does the name "Shiloh" refer to in Judah's blessing (often interpreted as)?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:10: "Until tribute (Shiloh) comes to him; and to him shall be the obedience of the peoples."

questions.question: What title for God is used in Joseph's blessing?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:24: "By the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (from there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel)."

questions.question: Which tribe is described as giving "royal delicacies"?
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:20: "Asher's food shall be rich, and he shall yield royal delicacies."

questions.question: What did Jacob do immediately after finishing his instructions?
options: He gathered up his feet into the bed and breathed his last
questions.correctAnswer: He gathered up his feet into the bed and breathed his last
questions.explanation: Genesis 49:33: "He gathered up his feet into the bed and breathed his last and was gathered to his people."

key_verse_text: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until tribute comes to him.
